title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
summary: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.

title: More than 60 U.S. stocks including Nvidia and Tesla are headed onchain. Here’s how it works
summary: The planned 24/7 venue will offer dozens of tokenized U.S. stocks, with trades conducted against stablecoins through blockchain-based liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book.

title: U.S. CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto regulations, though spot-market gap lingers
summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing two rules meant to cover the waterfront of crypto activity and exchanges, as long as it's not simple, direct trading.

title: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
summary: The payments giant is planning a major global expansion for its stablecoin cards business, and is exploring tokenized deposits and DeFi use cases, new crypto head Henri Stern said.

title: An XRP treasury SPAC surges nearly 300% ahead of Evernorth merger
summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II rose about 270% last week, leaving the thinly traded shell at nearly four times its roughly $10.50 trust value before merging with Evernorth, an XPR treasury company.
